name: Leatherworker's Tools

rules.text: Ability: dexterity. Utilize: Add a design to a leather item (DC 10). Craft: Sling, Whip, Hide Armor, Leather Armor, Studded Leather Armor, Backpack, Crossbow Bolt Case, Map or Scroll Case, Parchment, Pouch, Quiver, Waterskin. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.
